item: a stop in the instant the server starts is forwarded, not fatal (R674)
summary: HUP/TERM traps moved before the server spawn; a stop before the pid is known is kept and carried out after SERVER=$!. Before: a TERM in that gap killed the launcher (-15), skipped its EXIT trap and orphaned the server with no stop row. Two file-gated regression tests fail on the old script and pass on the fix. Same PR: the windowed-counts checkpoint test (red once on CI core-only shard 2, not reproduced at the same commit, install and placement, nor under load) now disposes the shared engine's pool before measuring and its contrast message names the reader's file and every checkpoint result.
